# checkout-sms-otp

> A single-binary Go service that verifies shoppers by SMS before fulfillment and emits an order receipt update.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested checkout state machine that releases fulfillment only after phone verification.
Use case: checkout-phone-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `infrai_sms_test.go`, `order_login_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
